A.question: Contados en dos fuentes sin censo común
A.population: 7 externally curated examples + 20 unmatched manually transcribed same-day events
A.outcome_proxy: counts, proportions or loss, not political virtue

B.H1: Counted totals differ across manually transcribed and curated tables
B.H0: Both sample means of counted choices equal
B.H_others: Manual data excludes no-vote counts while curated includes them: noncomparable administrative estimands.

C.design: Compare mean 350-category total to manual 3-category total; assess comparability
C.falsifier: Definitions match and sample distributions coincide.
C.budget: 7+20 secondary field rows, no new sampling
C.multiplicity: 30 exploratory claims, no unadjusted confirmatory testing

F.strongest_rival: Manual data excludes no-vote counts while curated includes them: noncomparable administrative estimands.
F.adversarial_audit: Seven curated votes or twenty manual transcriptions are exploratory and selected, not random.
F.selection_exposure: Entire 7 vote panel was inspected before design.
F.risk: Self-constructed endpoint and same DGP can mechanically favor one treatment.

H.posterior_update: No calibrated numerical posterior; descriptive or conditional update only.
H.abductive_rival: Manual data excludes no-vote counts while curated includes them: noncomparable administrative estimands.

I.reproducibility: Re-executable given frozen code/source and seed

J.reason: Another similar source snapshot or DGP realization is not an independent external validation.
